text:
emi (Design): quick design check — vectors preview export UX. Support reported CSV missing pinned id column. want default export to mirror visible columns + pinned first.

jonah (PM): yep. current CTA 'Export selection' is ambiguous. propose primary CTA 'Export selected rows' and modal header 'Choose columns to include in export'.

max (Eng): ok. front-end keeps visibleColumns + selectedRows. will pass ordered columns to backend and filter ui-only cols. sample: const payload = { rows, columns: visibleColsWithPinnedFirst, includePinned: true }

aria (a11y): accessibility: modal role=dialog, aria-labelledby, focus should land on first column checkbox. announce completion via sr-live region: 'Export ready: 10 rows'. ensure focus returns to export button.

sara (DevEx): copy note: default filename should indicate selection, e.g. 'vectors-selected-YYYYMMDD.csv' and fallback 'vectors-all-YYYYMMDD.csv'. primary CTA shorter: 'Export selected rows' with small link 'Export full dataset'.

emi (Design): action items: max -> PR to send ordered columns + pinned flag; aria -> keyboard + SR test cases; sara -> finalize compact CTA copy; emi -> update mock with column preview.

max (Eng): will do. targeting PR in next sprint.

emi (Design): thanks all, i'll post updated mock and attach interview notes about pinned columns preference.
